positions.gp_commentary_s1_2026: Second year of operations under AX ownership. H1 occupancy c.70%. ADR 61% and RevPAR 42% above competitive set. FY NOI outlook €1.4-1.5M. DANA 2025 indemnifications now total €1.1M with €100-150k pending in 2027; CAPEX came in below expectations generating €200-300k profit on that item.
